facts.answer: createAsyncStorage(name, {platform: "web"}).backend has kind "web" and describe().selectionReason in {"platform-capability", "indexeddb-platform"}. Unsupported platforms retain deterministic legacy fallback. createAsyncStorage must honor an explicit platform option and expose the selected backend's kind and selection reason while retaining legacy fallback behavior. createAsyncStorage(name, {platform: web}) returns a backend whose kind is web. The selected backend description reports a platform-capability selection reason (platform-capability or indexeddb-platform). PlatformAdapter keeps a deterministic fallback when no explicit platform is requested.

facts.answer: negotiateModule({turbo?, legacy?, name?}, {prefer?}?) returns an adapter. Callback-only legacy modules supply multiGet, multiSet, multiRemove, getAllKeys and clear; their adapter has describe().mode "fallback" and isFallback() true. Real TurboModule providers report "turbo" and false. Default preference is turbo; prefer "legacy" chooses an available legacy module. Callback errors reject the normalized Promise. ModuleNegotiator must detect a legacy callback module, expose fallback mode, and adapt callback results to the normalized asynchronous contract. negotiateModule with only legacy methods reports isFallback true. getValues resolves callback pairs into normalized records. Legacy multiSet, multiRemove, getAllKeys, and clear callbacks remain callable.

facts.answer: createAsyncStorage(name, {durable: true, persistentId}) uses a persistent backend; distinct names with the same persistentId share values. new MigrationManager({currentVersion}) exposes migrateScoped(storage, scope, targetVersion, transform); await it before exposing migrated state. The transform receives a scope-bound facade plus from/to versions; scoped getItem/setItem/removeItem take unprefixed keys. status() exposes version, state and history. Durable storage instances with the same persistentId must resolve to one persistent backend and observe one another's writes across scopes. createAsyncStorage with durable true and a persistentId selects the persistent backend. Two names sharing a persistentId read a value written by either instance. MigrationManager applies the scoped migration before the persistent state is exposed. Sharing includes concurrent ordinary writes from distinct handles: neither may overwrite unrelated peer values. Migration metadata storage is private; no user-visible reserved key such as __version is required. status().version advances only after a successful awaited transform, and stays at its previous version when the transform fails.
